source.close_reason: Done: dependency overrides clear OSV findings and OSV GitHub Action now pins concrete v2.3.8 tag so CI can resolve the action.
source.description: Pre-push OSV scanner reports existing vulnerabilities in ext/mercury-platform/package-lock.json: fast-uri 3.1.0 (GHSA-q3j6-qgpj-74h6, GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc), hono 4.12.12 (multiple GHSAs), and ip-address 10.1.0 (GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g). Not introduced by terminalbeta-9so; follow up by upgrading dependencies/regenerating lockfile and rerunning OSV.
source.notes: CI OSV action itself also fails because google/osv-scanner-action@v2 is not a resolvable tag; update workflow to current tag v2.3.8.
source.title: Resolve OSV scanner findings in ext/mercury-platform dependencies
